title: Notion vs Obsidian (2026): Cloud Workspace vs Local Second Brain
metaDescription: Notion vs Obsidian in 2026: compare pricing ($10/mo vs $0 core), offline privacy, databases, collaboration, and plugins to pick the right workspace.
intro: Notion and Obsidian are the two dominant knowledge tools of 2026, yet they take opposite architectural philosophies. Notion is a collaborative cloud database hub; Obsidian is a blazing-fast, local-first Markdown vault that you permanently own.
verdictSummary: Choose Notion if you work in a team needing real-time multiplayer docs, shared wikis, and structured relational databases. Choose Obsidian if you prioritize privacy, offline speed, plain-text ownership, and a $0 core app for solo research.

You rely on out-of-the-box Kanban, Timeline, and relational databases
You want bundled Notion AI Q&A and connectors inside Business ($20/user/mo)

faqs.question: Is Obsidian really cheaper than Notion in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes for individuals. Obsidian's core desktop and mobile app is $0 for both personal and commercial use, with optional Sync starting at $4/mo annually. Notion's Plus plan starts at $10/user/mo billed annually.

faqs.question: Which is better for team knowledge bases: Notion or Obsidian?
faqs.answer: Notion is far better for team wikis thanks to granular permissions, real-time multiplayer cursors, comments, and shared relational databases.

faqs.question: Can I move my notes between Notion and Obsidian?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both support Markdown export and import, and Obsidian includes an official Importer plugin that converts Notion export zips directly into clean Markdown vaults.

faqs.question: Do power users use Notion and Obsidian together?
faqs.answer: Frequently—many professionals keep private daily notes and research in Obsidian while publishing team specs and project boards in Notion.
